title: Evidence Handling Safety
description: Verification of evidence processing safeguards: file size limits, malicious file detection, hash verification, chain-of-custody metadata

findings.recommendation: Add @fastify/multipart with bodyLimit configuration for evidence uploads (500MB for video, 50MB for audio, 10MB for images)

findings.maxFileSize: Resource controls limit memory and CPU usage during OCR processing

requiredActions: Configure Fastify bodyLimit for evidence upload endpoints
Add per-file-type size limits (video: 500MB, audio: 50MB, document: 50MB, image: 10MB)
Reject oversized files before buffering to disk

findings.recommendation: Integrate ClamAV or equivalent virus scanner for all uploaded evidence files

capabilities: Content-type verification (checks MIME type matches file extension)

requiredActions: Add file magic byte validation (verify actual file type regardless of extension)
Implement sandboxed file processing (isolate evidence files from main application)

findings.description: Policy documents are hashed on ingestion for deduplication

findings.recommendation: Add SHA-256 hashing for all evidence files at upload time. Store hash in metadata for chain-of-custody verification.

requiredActions: Hash all evidence files (SHA-256) at upload time
Store hash in database alongside evidence record
Verify hash on retrieval to detect tampering
Implement hash chain for audit trail (each modification creates new hash referencing previous)

findings.description: Full audit trail for compliance finding lifecycle — tracks who did what and when
Evidence events track source type (bodycam, dashcam, audio) and creation timestamp
Review queue tracks who reviewed findings and when

findings.recommendation: Add dedicated EvidenceChainOfCustody model tracking: upload time, uploader, access log, modifications, export events

requiredActions: Create EvidenceChainOfCustody Prisma model with fields: evidenceId, action (uploaded/accessed/modified/exported), performedBy, timestamp, ipAddress, previousHash, currentHash
Log every evidence file access for chain-of-custody compliance
Implement tamper-evident logging (hash chain for audit entries)
Add evidence export tracking (who exported, when, to what format)

missingSafeguards: Evidence file upload size limits at API level
Evidence file hash verification on retrieval
Full chain-of-custody model for evidence files
prioritizedActions: 1. Add file size limits and type validation to evidence upload endpoints
2. Implement SHA-256 hashing for all evidence files at upload
3. Create EvidenceChainOfCustody model and log all access
5. Implement hash chain for tamper-evident audit trail
